E-mail Facebook: Church of the Feast of Christ the King. - A Different Kind of Kingdom The Feast of Christ the King—celebrated on the final Sunday of the liturgical year—invites us to reimagine what true power looks like. Unlike earthly rulers who hold authority through wealth, force, or status, Jesus reveals a kingship rooted in humility, truth, mercy, and self-giving love. Below are a few points worth considering. Service over status: Jesus leads as a shepherd who tends, protects, and seeks out the vulnerable rather than demanding to be served. Love over coercion: His reign is built on forgiveness, peace, and justice, even when met with mockery or suffering. A present call, not just a future hope: Praying "Your kingdom come" is a commitment to live out compassion, dignity, and solidarity right now.
